Publication statement: Beaumont, Texas : George W. White, [1923]
Shows lots and names of landowners. Also shows railroads, irrigation canals, precincts.

Shows lots and names of landowners. Also shows railroads, irrigation canals, precincts. Relief shown by hachures. Blue-line print. Mounted on cloth in 4 parts and annotations made with color crayon outlining the numbered boundaries of political subdivisions. Stamped at head of title and at bottom margin: Justice Precinct. "October 1923." Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
